**Finding: Compliant** (MINCOMMIT — no minimum purchase commitment)

- **§ 4.1 (p0052):** Charges arise only from Services specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, on a one-time, installment, recurring or usage basis — fees for usage/ordered services only, matching our preferred position.
- **No take-or-pay mechanics:** searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "volume" surface no committed-spend, committed-volume or shortfall-penalty language.
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142):** allocates sizing responsibility to Customer but imposes no usage floor or volume cap.
- **Exit preserved (§ 3.4, p0044–p0046):** Customer may terminate the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for convenience at month end on one month's notice, subject only to early termination charges "if any" under Attachment A.

No redline proposed. Flag for diligence: Attachment A and each Order Form sit outside this document and should be checked for committed volumes or early termination charges before signature.
